title: What happened in February?
notes: 9 February: warp and impulse cut from inside. Intact, crewed, fed, going nowhere;
long-range dark since; the transporters work (LORE.md 1b). Nothing about who.

lines.text: Ninth of February, oh-three-forty. Warp and impulse went together.
Not a fault. Somebody aboard cut them, and knew where to cut.
Rhel has been over it a hundred times. Clean work. Nobody saw.
We have power, air, food and transporters. We can't leave.
Long-range went dark the same hour. It hasn't come back.
Starfleet doesn't know we're here. There was nothing to file.
Nobody is coming. I say it out loud so I stop listening for them.
Rhel says a year, with a starbase. We don't have a starbase.
He talks to the core at night. I don't stop him.
The transporters are what matter. They're how we reach anyone.
I have a hundred and forty-one suspects and no proof.
Whoever it was didn't want us gone. They wanted us blind.
Ask me about the county. That's when it started to make sense.
